main.description: Registers bring-your-own PDS credentials for a community DID.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: CommunityCredentialsUnrecoverable
errors.description: The AppView cannot write to the community's repo and could not repair its own access.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A parameter or body field was missing or malformed.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A service outside this AppView failed.
